entities.name: Pearl-Ear
entities.description: A kitsune diplomat and long-time ambassador at Konda's court in Eiganjo.

entities.name: Sharp-Ear
entities.description: A kitsune ranger, Pearl-Ear's younger brother.

entities.name: Michiko Konda
entities.description: Konda's daughter, the princess Pearl-Ear tutored.

entities.name: Yoshino
entities.description: Konda's concubine and Michiko's mother, a friend of Pearl-Ear.

entities.name: Toshiro Umezawa
entities.description: A rogue who took Michiko away.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: A being whose shrine was set up in Konda's court and whom O-Kagachi sought.

entities.name: O-Kagachi
entities.description: A being that appeared over the Jukai in search of Kyodai.

entities.name: Sugi Hayashi
entities.description: Pearl-Ear's village, sacked by an akki army.

entities.name: Jukai
entities.description: The forest over which O-Kagachi appeared.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: The war during which these events took place.

events.summary: Pearl-Ear is present at Michiko's birth and brings the news to Konda, who is behaving strangely; she flees in fear.
events.quote: she felt a terrible portent from his words and the mood of the room and fled from there in fear

events.summary: Michiko, aged 20, sneaks from Eiganjo and is taken from Sugi Hayashi by Toshiro Umezawa.
events.quote: but Michiko was taken away by the rogue Toshiro Umezawa

events.summary: Pearl-Ear is imprisoned and then banished from Eiganjo.
events.quote: she was eventually banished from Eiganjo altogether

events.summary: Pearl-Ear finds her village in ruins after an akki sack and reunites with Sharp-Ear.
events.quote: found it in ruins after a sack by an akki army

events.summary: Pearl-Ear witnesses O-Kagachi's appearance, the climactic battle and the Daimyo's fate.
events.quote: She witnessed the climactic battle above the boughs, as well as the Daimyo's ultimate fate.

relations.quote: Pearl-Ear was a sister of kitsune ranger Sharp-Ear .
She was also a friend of Yoshino
the mother of Princess Michiko Konda
a long-time ambassador at daimyo Konda 's court in Eiganjo
